Author: dajoey
Name: Lazy Sightseeing
Punchline: Fully automated sightseeing log completions utilizing vnavmesh and lifestream.
Description: Automates the sightseeing log by finding uncompleted vistas, prioritizing active ones whose weather/time windows are currently open, flying/moving to them using vnavmesh, executing emotes, and automatically returning you to your configured inn via lifestream when done. Use /lazysight to open.
